The menu

Short menu, made fresh. Old-school Chicago deli classics, the Vienna Beef line done right, jerk chicken from the islands, and a bakery counter built around the Chicago Lunchroom Butter Cookie.

No pork on my fork A small stamp marks items on our all-beef line — Vienna Beef hot dogs and Polish, our corned beef and pastrami. Item by item, not a slogan.
Dessert From the bakery case to the box. Classic Chicago butter cookies, rich cheesecakes, and fresh-baked sweets to finish the job.
SIDE The necessary hardware for a proper meal. Golden fries, house-made slaw, and a crisp dill pickle spear on the side.
Plate Heavy-hitting dinners when a sandwich won't cut it. Sizzling jerk chicken and street tacos that demand a fork and a sit-down.
Deli The foundation of the house. Slow-cured corned beef and hot pastrami, stacked high on fresh marble rye. No shortcuts.
Dogs Authentic Vienna Beef, dragged through the garden. Classic Chicago dogs and grilled Maxwell Street Polish loaded with sweet onions.
Drinks Ice-cold sodas and refreshing pours to wash it all down. The perfect pairing for a heavy plate or a stacked sandwich.
